I’ve been coming to SP Salon since I was a child — more than 15 years now — and in all that time, there has never been a moment I felt disappointed. From the second you walk in, to the moment you leave, it’s clear that this place is something special.

What makes SP Salon stand out so brilliantly is the passion, expertise, and genuine warmth of the people behind it. The brothers, Santosh & Pramod Pawar, are true masters in their craft. Not only have they honed their skills over 15+ years doing styles for celebrities, cricketers, shoots, TV, films and ads, but they have always managed to balance artistry with attention to detail. Whether it’s a hairstyle, colour, facial, manicure—whatever I’ve asked for—they always understand exactly what I want (sometimes even before I do!). Their training, their eye for style, and their commitment to “science-based styling” (not just using trendy products, but knowing why something works for you) is evident in every single session.

I also want to give a special shout-out to Santosh: thank you, as always, for making every visit so enjoyable, for always going the extra mile, for listening (really listening) to what I want, and for making me feel great at the end. You’ve kept me coming back all these years not just because my hair looks good, but because I feel looked after — and that makes all the difference.

If you’re thinking of a salon that combines professionalism, artistry, experience and warmth — SP Salon is it. They don’t just style hair or give beauty treatments; they build trust, confidence, and happiness. Sincerely grateful to them for every haircut, every makeover, every time I walked out feeling fabulous.

Five stars, always. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
